ns2:course.label: The City Through the Body
ns2:course.description: Explores how we understand, represent and challenge urban conditions of oppression and inequality through the body. Using an international, interdisciplinary, and intersectional approach, this collaborative course uses theoretical and practical strategies from choreography and planning to tackle historical inequities in the urban context. Same as DANC 476. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
